item.title: ‘Join this club’: Macron urges PM Modi to ban social media for under-15
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron urged PM Modi to ban social media for children under 15, citing France’s upcoming ban and global efforts for child protection. Macron highlighted AI safety and digital well-being as G7 priorities, calling on India to join the growing club of nations, including Australia and Spain, implementing age restrictions to safeguard minors online.

item.title: AI Impact Summit: Sarvam AI brings chatbot to Nokia, HMD feature phones with local language support
item.description: Sarvam AI and HMD Global have announced a partnership to bring an AI-powered chatbot to Nokia and HMD feature phones at the AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi. The chatbot will support real-time conversations and multiple regional languages, expanding AI access beyond smartphones.

item.title: Will make AI as cheap as data: Ambani pledges Rs 10 trn investment at AI summit
item.description: Reliance group supremo Mukesh Ambani painted a picture of a world of super abundance with the help of AI as he pledged an investment of Rs 10 lakh crore over seven years starting this year. He also assured that his objective is to bring down the cost of AI to the level of data.

item.title: Vikram Bhatt, wife out on bail: Supreme Court halts cheating probe over flop films
item.description: The Supreme Court granted interim bail to filmmaker Vikram Bhatt and wife Shwetambari in a Rs 30 crore cheating case over a failed movie deal. The bench sent parties to mediation, questioning FIR jurisdiction in Rajasthan.

item.title: Meta and Nvidia sign multiyear AI deal as GB300 systems and Spectrum-X scale
item.description: Meta has announced a major strategic partnership with NVIDIA to build hyperscale data centers using millions of new GPUs and CPUs. The deal focuses on creating “personal superintelligence” for users while securing WhatsApp data through advanced Confidential Computing technology.

item.title: Caught on Cam| Lucknow woman storms substation, strangles and slaps staff over power cut
item.description: A Lucknow resident violently assaulted electricity department employees at the Vikas Nagar powerhouse after a dispute over a disconnected power line.

item.description: On 19 February, there is no point visiting as the India AI Impact Summit 2026, as access to the convention centre is invite only, and the Expo Arena is closed. However, the Expo will be open tomorrow, and the event has been extended by a day.

item.title: Jeep could bring Hemi V8 back in Grand Cherokee owing to demand
item.description: With a huge customer-base wanting to have the Hemi V8 make a comeback in the Jeep Grand Cherokee, the brand might just put it alongside the Hurricane 4 turbocharged engine.
